body.p: Bush Inn hotel was a hotel!

div.head: In the directories
div.p: The Bush Inn is in the directories from 1869 to 1925, on the corner of Bouverie Street and Victoria Street, so it is usually listed under both. It is No. 2 Bouverie Street, and No. 170 Victoria Street from 1905. See Hotels.

The directories list the proprietors as Jeremiah Quinlan (1869 to 1873), William Anderson (1874), Edward Mulcahey (1875 to 1880), Aron Lacey (1885), P. Hepburn (1890), Thomas C. Hunter (1895 to 1915) and William C. Nash (1920). No proprietor is given in 1925.

div.head: Neighbours
div.p: The Savings Bank is across Bouverie Street, at No. 176 Victoria Street from 1905 and No. 178 in 1920. In 1925 the Carlton Brewery (Carlton & United Breweries) is next door in Bouverie Street.

div.head: Records
div.p: The hotel's listings are linked to this entry, and the corner can be browsed in search.
